home.heroParagraph: A clear, shared place for organisations to publish safety documents and for the public to find the information that matters.
home.exploreParagraph: Search the public record by organisation, document title, or the category most relevant to your work.
home.howItWorksParagraph: Every record follows a simple path—from a clear submission to a searchable, public source of safety information.

home.step2Copy: Choose a category so others can find it easily.
home.step3Copy: Published records become available for public viewing.
home.ctaTitle: Have a safety document to share?
home.ctaParagraph: Submit a client record and attach your report. It takes only a few minutes.
home.footerTagline: Public safety records, designed for clarity.

submit.title: Share a safety record.

submit.publicDataNotice: By continuing, you confirm these details may be published in the public directory.

submissionErrors.CLIENT_SAVE_ERROR: We could not save the client record. Please try again.
submissionErrors.UPLOAD_ERROR: We could not upload the document. Please try again.
submissionErrors.DOCUMENT_SAVE_ERROR: The document was uploaded, but we could not finish the record. Please contact support.
